mps.name: Helena Dollimore
mps.summary: Helena Dollimore is the Labour (Co-op) MP for Hastings and Rye. Of the 26 Commons votes recorded since 3 November 2026, they voted in 26 (100%), always with most Labour (Co-op) MPs. They spoke 5 times in 4 debates (about 676 words); most often in "Business of the House", "International Update" and "Strengthening Community Resilience". They tabled 6 written questions, most often to the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (3) and the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (2). On the 19 votes where both the area's MPs voted, Helena Dollimore and Dr Kieran Mullan voted the same way 2 times and opposite ways 17 times.

mps.name: Dr Kieran Mullan
mps.summary: Dr Kieran Mullan is the Conservative MP for Bexhill and Battle. Of the 26 Commons votes recorded since 3 November 2026, they voted in 19 (73%), always with most Conservative MPs. They spoke 40 times in 9 debates (about 7,745 words); most often in "Welfare", "MOD Bicester and Illegal Migrants" and "Topical Questions". They tabled 11 written questions, most often to the Treasury (4) and the Ministry of Justice (3). On the 19 votes where both the area's MPs voted, Dr Kieran Mullan and Helena Dollimore voted the same way 2 times and opposite ways 17 times.
